summary: Aurelion Inc., a Hong Kong-domiciled foreign private issuer listed on a US exchange, furnished a Form 6-K disclosing a routine board committee reshuffle effective November 11, 2026. Mr. Herman Yu stepped down as a member and chair of the nominating and corporate governance committee, and Chairman of the Board Mr. Chang-Wei Chiu was appointed to both roles the same day. No financial terms, shareholder stakes, advisors or strategic alternatives were disclosed, and the change was board-approved rather than a forced or abrupt executive departure. The filing is a routine governance update with no deal or risk-arbitrage angle to monitor.
